depictions.name: Kerkasoros
depictions.text: Kerkasoros (Greek:Κερκασωρος) was an Egyptian village located in Ineb-Hedjet Nome. In 48 BCE, the Medjay Bayek of Siwa, passed by the village during his journey to Memphis to eliminate the Lizard, a member of the Order of the Ancients. In addition, Bayek destroyed a statue of Ptolemy XIII during his time in the village.
